concerns.text: Success Criterion SC-003 requires that the reaction‑time difference between high‑complexity and low‑complexity conditions be measured against the baseline reaction‑time. No task in the current task list implements this analysis (e.g., a task to compute, store, and report the RT difference or to include it as a predictor/outcome in the mixed‑effects model). This omission means the acceptance criterion cannot be satisfied, constituting a weakening of the specification.
